name: ECE 4244
title: Nanotechnology II
description: (Also offered as ENGR 4244.) Growth and characterization of cladded Si and Ge quantum dots (QDs), carbon nanotube using vapor phase nucleation; characterization using AFM and TEM and dynamic scattering techniques; device processing using nanolithography and QD self-assembly techniques; project work involving fabrication of devices such as quantum dot gate FETs, inverters and SRAMs, QD LEDs, carbon nanotube based FETs, and sensors using self-assembled quantum dots.
requirement_description: ECE 4211 or 4225 or ECE/ENGR 4243; open only to students in the College of Engineering.
